description: STRUCTURED document OCR via Apple Vision (RecognizeDocumentsRequest, offline). Returns JSON {transcript, tables} and preserves TABLES as rows/cells + reading order — unlike `ocr`, which flattens layout. Use for tables, forms, receipts, and multi-column documents.

path.description: Absolute path to an image (png/jpg/heic/tiff) or rendered PDF page.

name: recognize_document
